name: vLLM#52663: FP8 on RDNA3 exceeds 600s engine-ready timeout (no tuned configs)
notes: FP8 checkpoint on RDNA3 (gfx1100) loads and serves fine but exceeds 600s engine-ready timeout on first start. Root cause: no tuned W8A8 block-FP8 configs shipped for AMD_Radeon_Graphics, causing per-shape Triton JIT compilation. Cold start: 1474s. Warm: 49s. Fix: VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=1800. Demonstrates ROCm cold-start performance issue.
